title: &aSky, Ships and Lanterns
subtitle: Create Aeronautics airships, and the rings, lanterns and worlds of the Lantern Corps.

quests.title: Physics Be Upon Ye
quests.subtitle: Create Aeronautics
desc: &eCreate Aeronautics&r lets you build things that fly. The heart of every flying build is the &ePhysics Assembler&r: it turns a structure into a &eSimulated Contraption&r with real weight and momentum, and you can still walk around on it and use it.
Hold &eW&r over any Aeronautics block to Ponder it. Get a Physics Assembler.

quests.title: Head in the Clouds
desc: A balloon is a closed space walled with &eHot Air Envelope&r blocks. A &eHot Air Burner&r under it fills it with hot air, and the hot air lifts the contraption.
Bigger balloon, more lift. Heavy blocks (stone, metal) need more; planks and wool are light. Fill an airtight envelope.

quests.title: For Every Action...
desc: Lift gets you up; &ethrust&r moves you. A spinning &ePropeller&r (wooden or andesite) pushes the contraption the other way.
Place and power a propeller. A wrench reverses a Smart Propeller.

quests.title: In Thrust We Trust
desc: A &ePropeller Bearing&r builds a big propeller from the blocks you attach in front of it (sails work well). More blades, more thrust.
The &eGyroscopic Propeller Bearing&r tilts to stay upright: ideal for helicopters. Air gets thinner the higher you go, so engines lose power near the ceiling.

quests.title: Unidentified Floating Object
desc: &eLevitite&r floats. Attach enough of it to a contraption and the whole thing levitates, no balloon needed.
Make &eLevitite Blend&r and let it crystallize into Levitite (Ponder the blend to see how). The rarer Pearlescent Levitite is waiting to be discovered.

quests.title: An Engine That Flies
desc: A &ePortable Engine&r burns fuel to make rotation right on your contraption, so propellers turn wherever you go.
Fill it with coal, charcoal or wood. Place and power one.

quests.title: Hands on the Wheel
desc: A &eSteering Wheel&r turns your ship by hand: grab it and spin. A &eThrottle Lever&r sets engine power, and linked receivers let you fly from a cockpit.
Grab and spin a Steering Wheel.

quests.title: Thataway!
desc: A &eNavigation Table&r points toward a target (a map or compass item) and gives a redstone signal you can wire into your steering. An &eAltitude Sensor&r tells you how high you are.
Place a Navigation Table. With redstone, your ship can fly itself.

quests.title: Captain of the Clouds
desc: Lift, thrust, steering and a heading: put them together into a real airship or plane, with a deck your friends can stand on.
Fly it to a Sky Village or a Heavenly fortress. Name it with a &eNameplate&r; every good ship has a name.

quests.title: The Lantern Corps
quests.subtitle: Create: Lanterns
desc: Seven Corps, seven lights, one ring each. Rings aren't crafted: yours comes at the end of your class's road, from its &ering trial&r. The ring chooses; it refuses the unworthy.
The Guardians on Oa are watching who earns one. Until then, learn what the rings and lanterns do.

quests.title: The Ring Chooses
desc: Earn a ring through your class's ring trial. A lit ring lets you &efly&r (double-jump to take off, double-tap forward to shift up a gear, tap back to shift down), forms a hard-light &esuit&r that soaks hits, and keeps you breathing underwater.
Its &egrip&r grabs, hurls and pins things, even arrows in flight. Each light has two powers and an ultimate on the power key. Search 'Lantern' in Controls for the keys.

quests.title: In Brightest Day
desc: Everything the ring does costs charge. Craft the &eLantern&r of your light (see JEI) and stand within 6 blocks of it to start the charging ritual.

A Lantern holds a lot, but it only refills at a &eCentral Power Battery&r. An idle ring slowly recovers a little on your will alone, and dying costs it a quarter of its charge. A dropped ring flies back to you.

quests.title: Hard Light
desc: The &econstruct wheel&r lets you design, copy and summon &econstructs&r: shapes made of your light. A new bearer's construct holds 32 blocks; it grows with your will and with every minute your ring stays lit.

Stand on a construct you made and lift it with the grip key to ride it. Engines and burners on a construct run off your ring. Careful: crashing at speed digs a crater, so don't land in a friend's base.

quests.title: The Power Core
desc: A &ePower Core&r is the heart of a Central Power Battery: brass blocks, precision mechanisms and a beacon. It comes fully charged and keeps its charge if you break and replace it.
Make one. You'll need Create's brass and precision mechanisms (see the Create chapter).

quests.title: A Central Power Battery
desc: Build a frame of &ebrass casing&r, glass and your light's key block around the Power Core. A small battery reaches 64 blocks; medium and biggest reach two and four times as far.
It recharges Lanterns and rings in reach, keeps Blaze Burners lit, and turns a shaft under its core for Create (64 RPM). Your base's beating heart.

quests.title: Beyond the Sky
quests.subtitle: Leave the world
desc: The sky has a ceiling, and above it is &edeep space&r (Create Cosmonautics). There are two ways up:
&a1.&r A lit ring: keep flying up. Past about &e20,000 blocks&r the ring carries you out of the world, and keeps you breathing while its charge lasts.
&a2.&r A rocket: Cosmonautics' thrusters and engines (made with &etitanium&r, a new ore), plus a space helmet. Bring the whole party.
Out there you fly toward a world to land on it: the Moon, Oa or Korugar.

quests.title: Oa
desc: Far beyond the sky lies &aOa&r, the Guardians' world: the Citadel, the Guardian Outpost, the Lantern Spire, and the great Central Power Battery that recharges ten times faster than any other.
Fly there from deep space with your party and recharge every ring and Lantern you carry.

quests.title: Korugar
desc: Korugar is a darker world: the Dread Plains, the Fear Bogs, the Fear Spire and Sinestro's Watchtower. The Yellow light was born here, in fear and storms.
Reach it from deep space, by ring or by ship. Go armed.
